title: Taxonomy
description: A classification scheme: a hierarchy of levels, each a definition with criteria for what belongs to it.

Levels.description: The root level first, then every level below it in the order of the parent chain.

RootLevel.description: A level is a definition; the root level is one with nothing above it.

Level.description: A level below the root: a root level extended with its parent.

ParentLevel.description: The id of the level directly above.
